function.name: generate_image_tool
function.description: Generates an image based on the provided description and saves it with the specified file name. The image description should be detailed to ensure the resulting image matches the desired subject and surroundings; otherwise, these aspects will be chosen randomly. This function is not intended for generating images from textual data. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

desc.description: A single string that provides a detailed description of the desired image. For example, 'a sunset over the mountains with a lake in the foreground'.

file_name.description: The name of the file to which the generated image will be saved. It should include the file extension, such as 'image.png'.

function.name: tts_tool
function.description: Converts the provided text content to speech and saves the resulting audio to a file. This function is intended for voice narration and should be used accordingly. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

content.description: The text content that needs to be converted to speech.

speaker.description: The voice to be used for the text-to-speech conversion.

file_name.description: The name of the file to save the audio output without the extension. If left empty, a default name will be generated based on the content.

function.name: write_markdown_tool
function.description: Writes the provided content to a Markdown (.md) file on the disk. This function should be used when there is a need to persist text data in Markdown format as a result of a user action or a process that requires saving information in a structured text file. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

content.description: The Markdown formatted text content to be written to the file.

filename.description: The name of the file to which the Markdown content will be written. If not provided, a default filename will be used.

function.name: write_html_tool
function.description: Writes an HTML file to disk with the given content. Ensures HTML tags within the content are properly closed. This function should be used when there is a need to save HTML content to a file as part of a 'save' operation. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

content.description: The HTML content to be written to the file. Must contain valid HTML structure.

filename.description: The name of the file to which the HTML content will be written. If not provided, a default filename will be used.

function.name: search_web_tool
function.description: Executes a search query using the DuckDuckGo search engine and returns a specified number of search results from a given source. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

query.description: The search term or phrase to be queried.

num_results.description: The maximum number of search results to return. A positive integer.

source.description: The source from which the search results should be fetched.

function.name: get_url_content
function.description: Scrapes the specified URL for textual data and returns the content as a string. This function is useful for extracting information from web pages when a URL is provided. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: The web address of the page to scrape. It should be a valid URL format, such as 'http://www.example.com'.

timeout.description: The maximum time in seconds to wait for the server to send data before giving up, with a default value that allows for a reasonable amount of time for most web pages to load.

user_agent.description: The User-Agent string to be used for the HTTP request to simulate a particular browser, which is optional. Some websites may require this for access.

message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of the most common tools, APIs, and platforms you can use to book flights—whether you’re building a travel app, automating a booking workflow, or just looking for the best way to find and reserve seats.

| Category | Tool / Service | What it offers | Typical use‑case |
|----------|----------------|----------------|-----------------|
| **Flight Search & Booking APIs** | **Amadeus for Developers** | Full flight search, booking, and ancillary services (seat selection, baggage, etc.). Includes a “Flight Offers Search” endpoint that returns real‑time availability and pricing. | Building a custom travel booking platform or integrating flight data into an existing app. |
| | **Skyscanner API** | Search for flights, hotels, car rentals. Provides price alerts and multi‑city itineraries. | Quick flight price comparison and itinerary planning. |
| | **Google Flights API (via Google Travel)** | Access to flight search results, pricing, and seat availability. | Integrating Google’s flight search UI or data into a website or app. |
| | **Travelport Universal API** | Comprehensive travel content (flights, hotels, car rentals). Supports booking, ticketing, and itinerary management. | Enterprise travel agencies and large‑scale booking systems. |
| | **Expedia Rapid API** | Flight search, booking, and ancillary services. Includes a “Flight Availability” endpoint. | Building a travel aggregator or a travel‑booking app. |
| | **Kayak API** | Flight search, price alerts, and booking. | Price comparison and travel recommendation engines. |
| | **Priceline API** | Flight search and booking, plus hotel and car rental. | Travel agencies and corporate travel solutions. |
| | **Hopper API** | Predictive pricing and flight booking. | Apps that advise users on the best time to buy tickets. |
| | **OpenSky API** | Real‑time flight status and historical data. | Flight tracking and status monitoring. |
| | **FlightAware API** | Flight status, delay predictions, and historical data. | Real‑time flight tracking and notifications. |
| | **FlightStats API** | Flight status, delays, and airport data. | Flight status monitoring and travel disruption alerts. |
| | **IATA API** | Global flight data, schedules, and airport information. | Data‑driven travel analytics and compliance. |
| | **SITA API** | Airline operational data, passenger processing, and baggage handling. | Airline operations and B2B travel solutions. |
| | **Airline‑specific APIs** (e.g., Delta, United, Lufthansa) | Direct booking, seat selection, and loyalty program integration. | Direct airline booking or loyalty‑centric apps. |
| **Flight Search Engines (Web & Mobile)** | **Google Flights** | Web UI for searching flights, comparing prices, and booking via partner airlines. | Quick price comparison and booking. |
| | **Skyscanner** | Web & mobile UI for flight, hotel, and car searches. | Price comparison and multi‑city itineraries. |
| | **Kayak** | Web & mobile UI for flight, hotel, and car searches. | Price comparison and travel planning. |
| | **Expedia** | Web & mobile UI for flight, hotel, car, and package bookings. | All‑in‑one travel booking. |
| | **Priceline** | Web & mobile UI for flight, hotel, car, and package bookings. | Deal‑focused travel booking. |
| | **Orbitz** | Web & mobile UI for flight, hotel, car, and package bookings. | Travel booking with rewards program. |
| | **Hotwire** | Web & mobile UI for discounted flights, hotels, and car rentals. | Last‑minute deals. |
| | **Momondo** | Web & mobile UI for flight, hotel, and car searches. | Price comparison and multi‑city itineraries. |
| | **Hopper** | Mobile app that predicts flight prices and notifies you when to buy. | Price‑prediction and booking. |
| | **Trip.com** | Web & mobile UI for flight, hotel, and train bookings. | International travel booking. |
| | **Traveloka** | Web & mobile UI for flight, hotel, and activity bookings (Asia‑focused). | Southeast Asian travel booking. |
| | **Ctrip (Trip.com)** | Web & mobile UI for flight, hotel, and train bookings. | Chinese market travel booking. |
| | **Airbnb Experiences** | Not a flight booking tool, but often paired with flight booking for travel planning. | Travel experiences and activities. |
| **Travel Aggregators & Meta‑Search** | **Google Flights** | Aggregates flight data from multiple airlines and travel agencies. | Quick price comparison. |
| | **Skyscanner** | Aggregates flight data from airlines, travel agencies, and online travel agencies. | Price comparison. |
| | **Kayak** | Aggregates flight data from airlines, OTAs, and travel agencies. | Price comparison. |
| | **Momondo** | Aggregates flight data from airlines, OTAs, and travel agencies. | Price comparison. |
| | **TripAdvisor Flights** | Aggregates flight data and includes reviews. | Price comparison + reviews. |
| | **Google Travel** | Aggregates flight data and integrates with Google Maps. | Travel planning. |
| **Booking Automation & Bots** | **Selenium + Python** | Automate flight searches on websites like Google Flights or Skyscanner. | Automated price monitoring. |
| | **Puppeteer + Node.js** | Headless browser automation for flight booking sites. | Automated booking or price scraping. |
| | **Airfarewatchdog API** | Price alerts and flight search. | Price monitoring. |
| | **FlightAware Alerts** | Email/SMS alerts for flight status changes. | Real‑time flight status notifications. |
| | **FlightRadar24 API** | Real‑time flight tracking. | Flight status monitoring. |
| **Travel Management Platforms** | **Concur Travel** | Corporate travel booking and expense management. | Business travel. |
